name: Fayebael Noct
source:
Mysterious as she is beautiful, Faye has been visiting Limbo since before even Noel arrived.

At the Twilight Church (a nightclub), she has provided a safe space for the people of Limbo to take a break from their troubled lives in this realm between realms. 

How bad can Hell really be if she's there?
